mechanism: Both drugs are metabolized by CYP3A4 and CYP2D6; dutasteride may inhibit CYP3A4 leading to increased mexiletine levels and potential toxicity.
action: Monitor for mexiletine toxicity signs (tremor, dizziness, nausea, arrhythmias); consider mexiletine dose reduction if co-administered; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended.
